name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Auerhof
beschreibung: The Auerhof Farm Holiday Apartment is located in Ebbs, Tirol. The accommodation is run as an inn and therefore also offers dining services. The business combines agriculture with the rental of holiday apartments. Guests can enjoy regional products from its own production. The location in Ebbs allows for excursions to nearby Kufstein and the Kaisergebirge region. The rooms and apartments are simply and functionally furnished.
